description: The house as a Core 0.3 document with a hip roof whose FS_thermal data is its assembly from the shingles down to the gypsum ceiling - a vented attic stating its resistance, 6 1/2" of cellulose over the ceiling joists and 5 1/2" between them - framed 7%: the joists replace the core layer, the cellulose between them, and nothing else. Valid; the roof's derived values are beside the wall types' and floors', which are the 0.2 house's.
